subject: Banking
title: Banking as a Service
description: A quick, practical guide to Banking as a Service.

hook.text: Shopify offers business bank accounts. Uber has a debit card. Neither is a bank.

buildup.text: BaaS companies like Synapse and Unit provide banking infrastructure through APIs.

discovery.text: A licensed bank sits behind the scenes holding deposits and ensuring compliance.

twist.text: Synapse collapsed in 2024, freezing millions in customer funds.

climax.text: BaaS promised anyone could become a bank. Reality showed that banking requires stability.

punchline.text: Any company can offer banking. But banking requires trust that is hard to build.

quiz.question: What happened when BaaS provider Synapse collapsed?
options: Millions in customer funds were frozen because the middleware layer failed
